subject: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmarket.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our conversation, ResellerCo sent over their redlines for the Reseller Marketplace Addendum — I want to align on two commercial/legal items before we send anything to Procurement:

- Marketplace fees: ResellerCo is asking that Redwood absorb marketplace fees for listings (their standard asks). From our side we need to preserve a pass-through so Redwood is not materially disadvantaged.
- Order Form flow: They want the Marketplace Order Form to be the primary billing instrument; we usually need a carve that we invoice net of marketplace fees or show invoice detail for audit.

I attached the redline they sent. Can Marissa + Steph weigh in on whether we can accept the proposed language or suggest alternate wording that preserves our economics (and a short rationale we can share with their procurement)? Rishi — I know you have cadence with ResellerCo; if you can surface any flexibility on their side around showing marketplace fees on the invoice, that helps.

Goal: agree internally and respond with a clear redline + one-pager (commercial impact) by EOD Wednesday so procurement can finish approvals.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Head of Channel Sales | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmarket.com>

Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@resellerco.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Alex —

Appreciate the note. We've attached ResellerCo's suggested redline as a tracked-changes doc (Reseller_Addendum_ResellerCo_Redline.docx). High level: Procurement wants (1) Redwood to accept marketplace pass-throughs but also accept liability for customer-facing support in defined cases, and (2) a fiscal responsibility clause that places payment obligations on Redwood in the event of marketplace chargebacks.

I'm looping Procurement (Olivia) on this thread. Olivia — can you confirm whether showing marketplace fees as a separate line item on the invoice would be acceptable for audit on your end?

We prefer a short back-and-forth rather than full negotiation rounds. If you can propose a one-paragraph compromise we can take to Procurement, that would speed things up.

Best,
Liam

Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, CloudMarket
liam.oconnor@cloudmarket.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Alex / Rishi —

Thanks for the context and the redline. Quick legal read and open issues:

1) "Marketplace fees" definition — the draft doesn't clearly define scope (listing fees vs transaction fees vs service fees charged by the marketplace). We should define it narrowly and require ResellerCo to provide fee schedules or evidence on request.

2) Fiscal responsibility / chargebacks — we should not accept open-ended indemnity in exchange for pass-throughs. Proposed approach: allow pass-through of marketplace fees but include a limited gross negligence carveback and a 60-day cure period for disputed charges.

3) Invoice visibility — we can agree to itemized invoices (marketplace fees shown separately) but we need language that we will invoice net of marketplace fees where the marketplace collects payment directly.

4) Support / SLAs — avoid taking on first-line support obligations for marketplace listing issues. We can accept obligations for issues caused by Redwood's service, but marketplace listing platform issues should remain with ResellerCo or CloudMarket unless otherwise contracted.

I drafted suggested language for items 1–3 in the attached excerpt (proposed_redline_excerpt.txt). If you agree commercially, I'll produce tracked changes to the full addendum.

Short ask: Alex/Rishi — confirm that we can (a) require invoice visibility, (b) insist on the 60-day dispute/cure window, and (c) maintain the limited indemnity carve. Once confirmed I'll push a tracked redline back to Liam and Olivia.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Marissa — thanks, that read is helpful and aligns with our commercial constraints. To confirm formally:

- Itemized invoice visibility: OK — this is a must for ResellerCo's procurement. They want to show marketplace fees separately for their audit.
- 60-day dispute/cure window: OK.
- Limited indemnity carve: OK, but keep the language tight; we cannot accept open-ended liability for marketplace platform outages.

Commercial note for the response: If we insist on invoice visibility and the dispute window, that's usually sufficient for us to accept pass-throughs. However, if ResellerCo insists Redwood must contractually absorb chargebacks without recourse, we should escalate (not acceptable).

Rishi — can you push back gently on the "Redwood pays on chargebacks" idea and ask if Procurement will accept the 60-day cure + evidence requirement instead? If they still insist, flag for escalation to me and Steph.

I'll ask Marissa to produce the tracked redline (full addendum) plus a one-page commercial impact note (marketplace fee sensitivity at 5/10).

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmarket.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@resellerco.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:16:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Liam / Olivia —

Thanks for sending the redline. Attached is a short excerpt with proposed alternate language (proposed_redline_excerpt.txt) to address the primary concerns while preserving both parties' commercial positions. Key points in plain English:

- We will accept pass-through of documented marketplace fees provided the marketplace itself collects payment and/or the reseller provides an itemized fee report.
- Redwood will invoice the Customer net of marketplace fees where the marketplace collects payment; where Redwood invoices on behalf of the marketplace, Redwood will show marketplace fees as a separate line item and provide supporting documentation on request.
- For disputed charges or chargebacks, Redwood requests a 60-day dispute period and the right to investigate and cure before being held contractually liable.

If that framework is acceptable, I'll produce tracked changes to the full addendum and a one-page commercial impact summary for your Procurement.

Regards,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmarket.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@resellerco.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — billing & pass-through clause coordination

Liam / Olivia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, and thanks Marissa for the clear proposed language. Commercial summary for Procurement:

- Redwood will not absorb unexplained marketplace chargebacks. We will accept pass-through when the marketplace collects payment or when ResellerCo provides documented itemization.
- Redwood requests a 60-day dispute/cure window for any marketplace billing disputes.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will push a tracked-changes full addendum to you by EOD today.
2) If Procurement agrees to the framework, we'll finalize the Order Form and circulate a DocuSign link for signatures (I will include the Order Form link here: https://app.docusign.com/sign/RSC-2027-013-orderform).
3) If Procurement pushes back on chargebacks, Olivia — please advise and we'll schedule a 30-minute call to resolve.

Olivia / Procurement: please confirm whether itemized invoicing with marketplace fee lines is acceptable for your audit (this is the only outstanding procurement item).

Thanks — will follow up as soon as Marissa posts the tracked redline.

Best,
Rishi

--

Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
